Bharath Healthcare Laboratories Private Limited. (2026-09-22). GST · Registration and name reconciliation. Pinnacle Verification Centre evidence summary. https://pinnacle-verify.saripalli.chatgpt.site/evidence/records/gst.html

original The 2017 GST certificate records registration under the names printed on that document. The MCA name-change certificate supplies part of the corporate-name history. The original retains the former legal name. A current GST taxpayer record or amended certificate is needed before describing the current name and registration status as matched. GST registration does not establish clinical quality. Original source: BHARATH HEALTHCARE GSTIN CERTIFICATE OF BHARATH- FULL.pdf, pp1–3; MCA name-change certificate, p1.
